estimator.start: input-only zero facets and centered steps [-1,0,1]; independently cold for each q
estimator.retry: none; both stages mandatory for every returned finite point
estimator.covariance: invert structural information block with logSD excluded BEFORE inversion; no ridge/pseudoinverse

finite_numerical_limits.require: both optimizer stages successful; finite point; no certified structural recession/rank failure; unregularized SPD structural information

generating_mechanisms.normal_independent: person predictor Z; Z iid N(0,1)
generating_mechanisms.mixture_independent: person predictor .8Z+.6g; g=+1 for even person index and -1 for odd, exactly 100 per group; pair rows randomly permuted independently of outcomes
generating_mechanisms.mixture_selected: SAME realized .8Z+.6g pool and response uniforms; original unpermuted pair rows align g with base assignment block
generating_mechanisms.shared_task_total_variance: person predictor .8Z plus .6U_person,task shared by the two raters on a task; U iid N(0,1). Total latent variance1, person SD.8, different-task latent covariance.64. Bundles person-SD misspecification and within-task dependence; no presumed SE direction

common_random_numbers: For each independent replication SeedSequence([seed_entropy,replicate]) generates one Z vector, U N×3 array, outcome-blind pair-row permutation, and response uniforms N×2×3. Reuse across both designs and all mechanisms. Sampling is conditional on the fixed balanced g labels. No sample recentering or variance normalization.

assignment.weak_bridge: h=p//2; block=p%2; a=h%5; b=(a+1)%5; bridge=h%10==(h//10)%5; [5*block+a, 5*(1-block if bridge else block)+b]
assignment.permutation: Apply the SAME outcome-blind permutation of pair rows for normal_independent, mixture_independent and shared_task_total_variance; mixture_selected uses original pair rows. Person IDs/abilities and response uniforms stay fixed.
assignment.checks: 1200 rows and 40 persons/120 ratings per rater, 40 rows per rater/task; selected weak positive-group exposures38/40 for first5 raters and2/40 for last5; selected rotating20/40 for every rater. Counts describe constructed allocation, not empirical evidence of selection.

primary.contrast: mean first5 rater leniencies minus mean last5

task.contrast: Task T2 minus Task T0 severity

intervals: Nominal95% normal Wald with full structural covariance. Ignored-covariance comparator remains explicitly invalid approximation. Under misspecification, evaluate containment of GENERATING contrasts, not coverage of an assumed zero pseudo-true working-model parameter.

aggregation.unit: 12 independent replication seeds; scenarios sharing a seed are paired and are not independent additional replications
aggregation.cells: planned/eligible/statuses; eligible bias, biasMCSE, RMSE, empiricalSD, meanSE; generating-truth containment counts, binomial MCSE and Wilson95%; planned-denominator unresolved bounds
aggregation.decisions: Zero exclusion for the two generating-null rater contrasts is an exploratory false-flag measure. The task truth is+.6, so report generating-truth exclusion/containment, not false zero exclusion. No FDR or familywise claim.
aggregation.paired: selected minus independent mixture estimate per target within each design and seed, common-eligible count, mean difference and paired MCSE; retain all planned seed rows.

continuous_reference.cases: rep0 for all8 design×mechanism cells at q81 returned point
continuous_reference.engine: unchanged independent RaschIntegral with declared fixed blocks of10 persons; same full global coordinates
continuous_reference.refinement: All8 points, since N200; bound14 rel1e-12 abs1e-14 using original fixed-point checker
continuous_reference.targets: same checks extended to all3 prespecified contrast SEs
continuous_reference.interpretation: Checks integration of the fitted working-model likelihood only; cannot validate generating assumptions or interval containment.

resource_limits.failure_policy: retain all exceptions/timeouts/unrun planned rows; no retries or seed replacement

numerical_source: Copy the original medium_writing_20261023 frozen numerical files and fit driver, plus its additive block-reference helper, into the new study root. Verify copies by SHA256 before/after phases. No old sealed evidence writes.

literature.role: Eckes2009 printedpp39–40 discusses ability/severity confounding for disconnected designs. The connected weak-design stress here is our test, not a quoted finding.
Wang, Cheng and Wilson2005: shared stimuli can violate local independence. Coefficients .6/.8 here are deliberately chosen stress values, not empirical estimates.

limits: Exploratory12 replications per cell; nominal.95 proportion MCSE~6.29percentage points and maximum14.43pp at.5. Fixed balanced groups and one stress strength; no empirical selection detection, general robustness certification, population-distribution inference, or release of application inference holds.
